name: Abdur Rashid Tarkabagish
contribution: Abdur Rashid Tarkabagish was a Muslim League-era politician who became an important opposition voice in East Pakistan.
context: He criticised centralised rule and represented provincial demands for dignity, representation, and control over East Bengal’s political future.
impact: His career helped articulate a rights-based language of opposition before the autonomy movement reached its later stages.
